tests.name: Chart — mount mounts a canvas and calls createChartController with type "bar"
Chart — mount mounts a canvas and calls createChartController with type "line"
Chart — mount mounts a canvas and calls createChartController with type "bubble"
Chart — mount mounts a canvas and calls createChartController with type "scatter"
Chart — mount mounts a canvas and calls createChartController with type "doughnut"
Chart — mount mounts a canvas and calls createChartController with type "pie"
Chart — mount mounts a canvas and calls createChartController with type "polarArea"
Chart — mount mounts a canvas and calls createChartController with type "radar"
Chart — mount mounts a canvas and calls createChartController with type "candlestick"
Chart — mount mounts a canvas and calls createChartController with type "ohlc"
Chart — mount mounts a canvas and calls createChartController with type "boxplot"
Chart — mount mounts a canvas and calls createChartController with type "violin"
Chart — mount mounts a canvas and calls createChartController with type "matrix"
Chart — mount mounts a canvas and calls createChartController with type "sankey"
Chart — mount mounts a canvas and calls createChartController with type "treemap"
Chart — update updates in place via handle.update when data changes, without calling createChartController again
Chart — update calls handle.update (not createChartController again) even when type itself changes — core decides update-vs-recreate internally, not this component
Chart — update serializes overlapping prop changes through one promise chain rather than racing
Chart — update re-reads handle.chart after update, since a type-change recreate swaps the underlying instance under the same handle
Chart — update reacts to a nested mutation of a reactive `data` object, without ever replacing the prop reference itself
Chart — plugin opt-ins passes a custom plugins array straight through to createChartController
Chart — plugin opt-ins does not apply any plugin when the corresponding prop is omitted
Chart — plugin opt-ins applies zoom with no extra config when the prop is `true`
Chart — plugin opt-ins applies zoom with the given config object
Chart — plugin opt-ins applies annotation only when given a real config object — no plain-boolean form, unlike zoom/dataLabels
Chart — plugin opt-ins applies dataLabels with no extra config when the prop is `true`
Chart — plugin opt-ins applies dataLabels with the given config object
Chart — plugin opt-ins applies gradient when the prop is `true` — boolean only, no config-object form
Chart — plugin opt-ins applies timestack when the prop is `true` — boolean only, no config-object form, same shape as gradient
Chart — plugin opt-ins applies hierarchical when the prop is `true` — boolean only, no config-object form, same shape as gradient/timestack
Chart — plugin opt-ins threads all three plugins together into the same options object without clobbering each other
Chart — plugin opt-ins threads gradient alongside the other three plugins without clobbering their options.plugins.* entries
Chart — plugin opt-ins threads timestack alongside all four other opt-ins without clobbering their options.plugins.* entries
Chart — plugin opt-ins threads hierarchical alongside all five other opt-ins without clobbering their options.plugins.* entries
Chart — exposed chart ref is null before mount resolves, then the live Chart.js instance once it has
Chart — accessibility forwards non-prop attributes (e.g. ARIA attributes) onto the rendered canvas element
Chart — accessibility renders default slot content as real fallback content inside the canvas tags
Chart — unmount destroys the handle exactly once on unmount
Chart — unmount does not crash when unmounting after mount() itself never resolved a handle
index.ts (public entry point) re-exports the Chart component
